nodes.label: Cellular Automata Simulation
nodes.rationale: GPU-accelerated cellular automata with checkerboard update pattern avoids race conditions on single-buffered RGBA8 textures

nodes.label: Checkerboard CA Update Pattern
nodes.rationale: Even/odd phase dispatch avoids write-after-read conflicts in single-buffered GPU textures, removing need for double-buffered chunk textures

nodes.label: Stage-Based World Generation Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Each generation stage is a separate GLSL file, orchestrated by a single shader dispatch — enables incremental feature addition without monolithic shader changes

nodes.label: Temperature-Driven Burning (No FIRE Material)
nodes.rationale: Wood burns based on temperature directly rather than converting to a separate FIRE material — burning wood stays MAT_WOOD, spreads heat, consumes health, and becomes air at zero health

nodes.label: Temperature-Scaled Spread Probability
nodes.rationale: Each burning neighbor rolls a probability check before spreading heat, scaling from 0% at IGNITION_TEMP to 70% at FIRE_TEMP — makes fire spread irregular and natural rather than uniform

nodes.label: Ember Color Gradient & Flicker Animation
nodes.rationale: Burning wood transitions from dark red through orange to yellow-white as temperature increases, with TIME-based flickering via multi-frequency sine waves and per-frame random seeds for heat variation

nodes.label: Pull-Based Fluid Advection
nodes.rationale: Gas uses pull-based advection: each cell pulls from neighbors based on velocity components, with stochastic integer division for density transfer and wall reflection by flipping velocity sign

nodes.label: Frame-Budget Collision Rebuild (1 per frame)
nodes.rationale: Rebuild only one chunk's collision per frame (nearest-to-player first) instead of all dirty chunks — eliminates the ~0.5s stall on chunk-row loads, with cached has_burning flag refreshed every 10th rebuild instead of per-rebuild GPU readback

nodes.label: Lava: Velocity-Driven Flow Only (No Diffusion)
nodes.rationale: Lava flows via velocity advection only (no diffusion spreading) unlike gas, making it heavier/pool-forming; lava temperature decays over time and hot lava cells act as heat sources for flammable neighbors

nodes.label: Occluder Polygon Inset (3px shrink)
nodes.rationale: Shrink light occluder polygons inward by 3px matching near_air() radius so wall top outer rings that should be visible receive light instead of being shadowed

nodes.label: Multi-Chunk Cave Generation (Primary/Secondary pairs)
nodes.rationale: Multi-cave chunks pair primary and secondary across chunk boundaries with shared-edge skip to create seamless cross-chunk cave shapes via common FBM noise seed

nodes.label: Tunnel Carving with Noise-Displaced Paths
nodes.rationale: Tunnel chunks connect connector points via noise-displaced linear paths with endpoint fade to clean connections — odd remaining connectors get dead-end stubs

nodes.label: Deterministic Edge Connector System
nodes.rationale: Connectors between adjacent chunks use canonical edge keys for deterministic hash-based placement of 0-2 openings per edge at non-corner positions

nodes.label: has_burning Cached Flag (CPU-side bookkeeping)
nodes.rationale: Replace per-rebuild sync GPU texture readback to check for burning state with a CPU-side has_burning boolean, set by place_fire and refreshed every 10th rebuild (~3s) to catch fire decay

nodes.label: Velocity Damping (15/16 per frame)
nodes.rationale: 15/16 velocity damping per frame makes gas clouds slow down gradually rather than oscillating indefinitely

nodes.label: Elastic Overshoot Swing Animation
nodes.rationale: Two-phase swing: elastic ease-out overshoots past end angle by 30 degrees in the first 65% of duration, then smoothly eases back to idle in remaining 35% — replaces mechanical linear swing with natural feel

nodes.label: Data-Driven Weapon/Modifier Runtime (SP-A)
nodes.rationale: Single Modifier subclass reads category/trigger/condition/effect/element/magnitude from CSV — eliminates 46 bespoke scripts in favor of a dispatch runtime plus 11 kept for complex cases; weapons built entirely from CSV rows with archetype column, deleting .tres files

nodes.label: Juicy Melee Hit System (5 Juice Managers)
nodes.norm_label: juicy melee hit system (5 juice managers)

nodes.label: Light Pack Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Aggregates glowing pixels (MATERIAL_GLOW > 1.0) per chunk into up to 16 PointLight2D nodes using a compute shader dispatch at 12Hz, reading back distributed across 5 frames to avoid GPU stalls.

nodes.label: ChunkLights
nodes.rationale: Manages 16 PointLight2D nodes per chunk with smooth lerp interpolation between light data updates for organic-looking illumination.

nodes.label: Terrain Probe Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Replaces empty _grid cache in TerrainPhysical with tiny GPU probe SSBO + readback path (~256 B per frame) so query() returns real material data, fixing natural-enemy-spawn and lava-damage bugs.

nodes.label: Enemy FSM
nodes.rationale: FSM-based enemy AI with states WANDER, CHASE, WINDUP, ATTACK, COOLDOWN, HURT, DEATH in the Enemy base class. Subclasses override _execute_attack().

nodes.label: Elite System
nodes.rationale: Data-driven via is_elite flag. Elite abilities: FAST (halve windup/cooldown), TANK (2x health, slower), TELEPORT (reposition on hit), ENRAGE (damage boost below 30% HP).

nodes.label: Card Controller
nodes.rationale: Reusable Card Control scene wrapping a SubViewport with fake_3D perspective-tilt shader, elastic hover animations, and offset drop shadow. Replaces inline programmatic card creation across all UI screens.

nodes.label: Wander Behavior
nodes.rationale: IDLE state renamed to WANDER with random-direction + pause cycle. Enemies pick random direction, move for 1-3s, pause 0.5-1.5s.

nodes.label: Exclamation Telegraph
nodes.rationale: Red '!' Label popup above enemies during WINDUP state, telegraphing incoming attacks Soul Knight style.

nodes.label: place_blood
nodes.rationale: New API through TerrainSurface -> WorldManager -> TerrainModifier chain with per-pixel radial velocity for blood fluid splatter on enemy hits.

nodes.label: Material Hardness
nodes.rationale: New hardness float field in MaterialDef feeding carve pipeline. Effective carve radius = base_radius * clamp(damage/(damage+hardness), 0.1, 1.0). Softer materials (dirt=0.5) carve wider; harder (stone=5.0) carve narrower.

nodes.label: TerrainImpact
nodes.rationale: Autoload mapping material_id to particle colors, counts, and sounds for impact debris feedback.

nodes.label: IntentIndicator
nodes.rationale: Standalone Node2D + Label scene handling its own animation (flash-in, idle pulse, exit) via tweens. Enemy base class instantiates it on WINDUP entry.

nodes.label: JuicyPanel
nodes.rationale: Base class extending Control providing open()/close() with inspector-configurable backdrop, drop-in animation, and content stagger. Every modal UI panel uses this shared juicy feel.

nodes.label: Wall-Block Auto-Facing
nodes.rationale: When player is blocked by terrain, input direction overrides auto-face so player can carve terrain; otherwise auto-face to nearest enemy.

nodes.label: WeaponInfoPopup
nodes.rationale: CanvasLayer (layer=15) owned by PickupContext showing floating info card above highlighted weapon drop with name, damage, cooldown, modifier icons.

nodes.label: Parry System
nodes.rationale: Hollow Knight-style parry on player's melee swing: a time window at swing start where enemy melee hits are nullified, both entities are knocked back, and NailClashFX plays with hitstop and camera shake.

nodes.label: Projectile Block
nodes.rationale: Soul Knight-style projectile destruction during melee swing arc. Any enemy projectile in the arc is destroyed with ProjectileBlockFX spark effect.

nodes.label: Walkability Invariant
nodes.rationale: Every cave chunk must contain a contiguous open pocket of >= 150x150 px reachable through >= 24-px openings, enforced via JFA distance transform + strip-pools + dilate GPU stages.

nodes.label: Jump-Flood Algorithm (JFA)
nodes.rationale: GPU distance transform using 8 passes of decreasing stride (128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1) to compute per-cell Chebyshev distance to nearest solid. Uses ping-pong RG32I scratch textures.

nodes.label: MAT_OIL
nodes.rationale: Flammable liquid material that flows like lava. Non-auto-ignitable; ignites via direct contact with lava/fire. Burning oil seeds MAT_EXPLODE_WAVE at end-of-life.

nodes.label: MAT_EXPLODE_WAVE
nodes.rationale: Custom radial-shell propagation sim. Air cells with wave neighbor become wave with power-4; wave cells revert to air. Scorches surroundings, damages terrain and entities.

nodes.label: ArenaComposition
nodes.rationale: Data-driven room definition resource replacing rectangular PNG stamps. Contains features list of ArenaFeature subclasses that sample positions from ArenaRegions and spawn entities or stamp material discs.

nodes.label: ArenaFeature
nodes.rationale: Base class hierarchy for arena features: FeatureBossSpawn, FeatureEnemyPack, FeaturePillarCluster, FeaturePoolPatch, FeatureBarrelCluster, FeatureVent, FeatureChestSpawn.

nodes.label: ArenaRegion
nodes.rationale: Spatial sampling hierarchy: RegionPoint (fixed offset), RegionDisc (uniform area in circle), RegionRing (uniform area in annulus), RegionArc (uniform area in angular arc).

nodes.label: chunk_flags_tex
nodes.rationale: R8 storage texture companion to chunk_tex carrying a NO_PROPS mask (bit 0). Written by walkability_enforce and pixel_scene_stamp; read by stage_biome_props to prevent prop placement in protected regions.

nodes.label: NO_PROPS Flag
nodes.rationale: Bit 0 of chunk_flags_tex preventing prop placement in guaranteed walkable pockets, stamp footprints, and cavern-carved interiors.

nodes.label: DESTRUCTION_TABLE
nodes.rationale: Branchless 256-entry per-material lookup table baked into materials.glslinc. When a solid is destroyed, a hash byte indexes this table to determine the replacement material (e.g., stone -> 40% sand_dust, 60% air).

nodes.label: Wardstone Ring
nodes.rationale: World boundary at sector Chebyshev distance 10: indestructible wardstone ring at the outer edge, and void_stone fill for sector distance 11+.

nodes.label: Powder Sim
nodes.rationale: Static-pile simulator for MAT_ICE_POWDER and MAT_SAND_DUST. Ice powder melts near heat (temp >= 100) into water. Sand dust is fully inert. Both dispersible by melee arc.

nodes.label: Explode Wave Shell
nodes.rationale: Pulled-write model where each AIR cell looks at 4-neighbors for wave cells and adopts max-power-WAVE_DECAY. Wave cells self-decay to scorched air (SCORCH_TEMP=100) to prevent backfill. Forms expanding diamond front.

nodes.label: Oil Fluid Sim
nodes.rationale: Reuses existing fluid advect-pull mechanics (modeled on lava.glslinc). No heat diffusion from neighbors; temperature rises only via direct lava/fire contact. When burning oil reaches health==0, seeds MAT_EXPLODE_WAVE instead of decaying to air.

nodes.label: Cavern Carve
nodes.rationale: GPU stage reading per-chunk cavern SSBO. Carves organic shapes using angular noise (4-harmonic sine sum with per-cavern seed) to modulate base radius with lobing amplitude. Writes MAT_AIR + NO_PROPS flag.

nodes.label: CompositionDispatcher
nodes.rationale: Autoload post-gen GDScript pass hooked to chunks_generated. Walks ArenaComposition features, samples positions from ArenaRegions within mask_air constraints, spawns entities and stamps material discs.

nodes.label: SectorGrid Claim
nodes.rationale: Boss anchor spacing: every 8th sector on Chebyshev-10 ring is a boss anchor. Each anchor claims a 7x7 sector block (Chebyshev radius 3) so no two bosses overlap and claimed sectors are empty.

nodes.label: Arena Rework
nodes.rationale: Shrinks elite (r=224->140) and boss (r=960->300) arenas and packs each variant with terrain features (pillars + pools + barrels + vents) for a dense, crammed feel.

nodes.label: Hazard Bitmask
nodes.rationale: Per-sub-cell hazard bitmask piggy-backed onto the existing 4x4 light extraction pipeline. HAZARD_LAVA=1, HAZARD_FIRE=2, HAZARD_OIL=4, HAZARD_BLOOD=8. Enables coarse-grain terrain damage gating.

nodes.label: Double-Buffered Terrain Probe
nodes.rationale: Two SSBO pairs (ping-pong) for terrain probe input/output. Each frame: read last frame's results from inactive buffer, dispatch new probes to active buffer, flip index. Eliminates GPU sync stall.

nodes.label: Melee Arc GPU Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Fire-and-forget compute shader for terrain modification on melee swings. Includes 3-frame-lagged ring-buffer hit list for deferred impact FX. Eliminates CPU-side per-cell terrain clearing loop.

nodes.label: Coalesced Light Readback
nodes.rationale: Replaces per-chunk light_output_buffer with two shared double-buffered SSBOs. Each frame: one buffer_get_data reads all chunks' light data at once, then flip. Eliminates ~4.21ms per-frame stall.

nodes.label: Coalesced Collider Readback
nodes.rationale: Mirrors light pipeline: single shared SSBO with N slots, persistent per-chunk uniform sets, one compute_list_begin/end per frame. Dirty-flag tracking drives selection so steady-state cost is ~0ms. Occluder construction amortized to <= 1 chunk/frame.

nodes.label: Bundled Weapon Modifier Drops
nodes.rationale: Rolls modifier at enemy spawn (not death) so it is active during combat and rides with weapon when dropped. Regular enemies no longer drop standalone weapons/modifiers from random pools.

nodes.label: Hit Flash and Squash
nodes.rationale: Per-enemy sprite flash to white and squash/stretch tween on hit. Already defined methods _play_hit_flash() and _play_squash() were orphaned before this plan.

nodes.label: NailClashFX
nodes.rationale: Static helper instantiating nail-clash scene with particles, expanding shockwave ring shader, hitstop (0.12s time_scale=0), and camera shake for dramatic parry feedback.

nodes.label: ProjectileBlockFX
nodes.rationale: Static helper for lightweight spark effect when melee swing destroys a projectile.

nodes.label: fake_3D Shader
nodes.rationale: Canvas item shader applying perspective tilt to card face via rotation matrix + projection, giving a faux-3D card effect driven by mouse position.

nodes.label: animated_root Export
nodes.rationale: NodePath export on JuicyPanel accommodating the prevalent CanvasLayer-wrapper pattern where the visual element being animated is an inner node.

nodes.label: Perimeter Material
nodes.rationale: Per-biome accent material for boss arena perimeters and landmark features. Five variants: STONE_BRICKS (caves), WOOD_BEAM (mines), OBSIDIAN (magma), PACKED_ICE (frozen), ENGRAVED_METAL (vault).

nodes.label: Cracked Material
nodes.rationale: Per-biome cracked variant material used as visual hint for secret chest rooms embedded in terrain.

nodes.label: Secret Solid Validation
nodes.rationale: For secret stamps: probe 32x32 region around stamp center via 25-point sampling; if < 90% solid, skip entire stamp. Ensures secrets only place inside solid terrain.

nodes.label: PropDispatcher
nodes.rationale: Autoload hooked to chunks_generated that scatters entity props (wooden pillars, barrels, vents) using Poisson sampling within chunks, validated against foot-print air checks.

nodes.label: TerrainCell Interning
nodes.rationale: MaterialRegistry.get_cell() returns same TerrainCell instance per material_id. Reduces GC pressure from repeated TerrainCell.new() calls in query hot path.

nodes.label: Bounded Pending Probe FIFO
nodes.rationale: Caps _pending_probes Dictionary at MAX_PENDING=1024 with FIFO eviction, preventing unbounded growth from rapid movement.

nodes.label: attackable_hit Physics Layer
nodes.rationale: Dedicated physics layer for hit-testing. Melee weapons use PhysicsServer2D.intersect_shape against this layer instead of iterating all nodes in 'attackable' group.
